title: Answer: the public pages state no account of what consciousness is

statements.text: Matter As Machine takes no position on what consciousness is. The word appears where the site doubts that consciousness replaced instinct in people: what is felt as natural and freely chosen may be an instinct at work, as a beaver might call its dam building a higher, conscious activity. Feelings are read as parts of an algorithm, and the pages do not say what being conscious is.

sources.quote: Scientists claim that "humans have no instincts", that humans "replaced animal instincts with consciousness / awareness / whatever". But is this true?
Maybe they would say something like "building is our higher, conscious activity"?
